**Mont Ventoux Observatory – Handover Summary (≤150 words)**  

- Telescopes: 60‑cm reflector (installed 2017) and 20‑cm outreach refractor.  
- Weather: ≈195 useful nights / yr (168 in 2024).  
- Data flow: ≈400 GB per night (≈400 GB / month) transferred to Marseille in ~40 min; exact nightly/monthly split is uncertain.  
- Camera: Main camera replaced March 2025, read‑noise ↓30 %; requires one full‑night offline firmware update.  
- Past incidents: 2023 dome‑motor seizure bent the counterweight rod (repaired, limit switch added). Feb 2025 a 1.2 s timestamp offset (undetected) lost three weeks of photometry; all sessions now GPS‑checked.  
- Rules: No observing on outreach evenings; raw frames are compressed (policy varies—some notes say never deleted, others after two years); acquisition‑software changes need a dedicated test night.  
- Collaboration: Spanish team awaiting review/evaluation of a shared scheduling tool; simultaneous‑transfer network capacity is unknown (uncertain).
